content:
maria_cs: FYI — BlueForge renewal is due next Friday. They're asking to change term to 9 months and split payment (50% CC, 50% PO). Need routing for procurement + eSign.
jamal_se: Thanks. Account health is good — QBR went well, usage up 22% month-over-month. They want the term shortened for budget timing.
riley_finance: CC vs PO split ok but we need vendor code and PO reference before we can invoice the 50% via PO. Ask procurement to confirm vendor code.
maria_cs: They sent a PO draft in email but it's missing our vendor code and has Net45 payment term. Customer wants Net30. See snippet they sent:
```
PO#: BF-2026-332
Amount: $120,000
Payment terms: Net45
Bill to: BlueForge, Inc
```
jamal_se: We prefer Net30 for renewals < $150k. Can we accept Net45 if they provide guarantee? leaning no.
olivia_legal: I'd prefer Net30 as well. If Finance insists on Net45 we need approval from Legal for extended terms. Also need signature block updated for delegated signatory (they're using a procurement agent).
harper_enablement: Onboarding for the two new seats is scheduled week after renewal — can we lock start date conditional on full payment/PO being received?
maria_cs: Customer asked to start seats on 2026-05-04 regardless of PO timing. Risk: activations before funds received.
riley_finance: If seats are activated before PO clears we need a signed amendment referencing the split billing and a receivables hold. Suggest: amend SOW with clause: "Activation contingent on payment schedule below".
olivia_legal: I can draft a short amendment. We should also use Docusign for signature. Who will push the eSign envelope?
procurement-bot: @maria_cs — docusign template "renewal-split-payment-v1" available. I can auto-populate PO and terms if you confirm fields.
maria_cs: Please populate with PO# BF-2026-332, term 9 months, payment split 50/50, payment terms Net30 on CC portion and Net45 on PO portion (customer requested). Also set a clause: activation contingent on PO acceptance or second payment within 30 days.
procurement-bot: Template queued. Draft link: https://docusign.example/tx/ABCD1234
jamal_se: I'll ping the BlueForge procurement lead to confirm vendor code and get them to attach the PO with vendor code.
riley_finance: Also need billing entity confirmation — customer listed "BlueForge, Inc" but our contract is under "BlueForge US LLC". If mismatch, finance needs entity swap paperwork.
olivia_legal: If entities mismatch we need a counterparty amendment. Ask them to provide legal entity name and signatory authority doc.
harper_enablement: If amendment delays signature past activation date, can we provision seats as "suspended" until PO clears? That avoids manual deprovisioning later.
riley_finance: We can temporarily provision but put seats in a billing hold state in our console; need ops to support that.
maria_cs: Action items:
- @jamal_se confirm vendor code & legal entity with BlueForge (today)
- @procurement-bot prepare Docusign with fields above (inflight)
- @olivia_legal draft short amendment for delegated signatory + entity swap if needed
- @riley_finance confirm invoicing flow and provisional activation hold
I'll update customer once we have vendor code.
jamal_se: On it, pinging them now. cc @harper_enablement so they know potential start shift.
olivia_legal: drafting amendment, ETA EOD today.
procurement-bot: Docusign envelope ready for review: https://docusign.example/tx/ABCD1234/review
maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll hold off on confirming activation date with BlueForge until vendor code and amendment draft are confirmed. :thumbsup:
jamal_se: BlueForge replies: vendor code is VF-7788, legal entity is "BlueForge LLC" (US). They attached signed PO and signed procurement agent letter. Sending files to @olivia_legal now.
maria_cs: Received — attaching to thread. Next steps should be quick if legal approves.
olivia_legal: Reviewed attachments. Vendor code OK. Procurement agent letter suffices for delegated signatory. I'll finalize amendment and route via Docusign. ETA 2 hours.
riley_finance: Once signed, finance will invoice: CC portion charged immediately (Net30) and PO portion invoiced to PO VF-7788 (Net45). Finance approves provisional activation with billing hold until payment/PO processed.
harper_enablement: Great — we'll tentatively schedule onboarding for 2026-05-04 and mark as "pending billing" in the enablement tracker.
maria_cs: Closing loop — I'll send customer a brief update with timeline and link to Docusign. Thanks everyone.
jamal_se: :rocket:
